title: Custom Colonial in Duxbury, Massachusetts
description:
Presented by Macdonald & Wood Sotheby's International Realty

For more information go to: http://ow.ly/KSB5e


This 5 bedroom Colonial sits at the end of a cul-de-sac and is perfect for entertaining. From the foyer, you can see the gracious living room, large dining room and family room with stone fireplace beyond. All rooms have hardwood flooring, crown moldings, recessed lighting and high ceilings. The kitchen has an extra-large island, granite countertops, double ovens and stainless steel appliances. Upstairs there is a master suite complete with dressing room/walk-in closet and a full bathroom with Jacuzzi tub. There are four additional bedrooms and a full bath. The basement has been finished with a massive playroom with a wall of custom built-ins, an au pair suite with full bath and two generously-sized storage rooms. Summer fun is guaranteed with the bluestone patio, farmer's porch, deck, outdoor shower and the wonderful outdoor kitchen - complete with built-in gas grill and sink. The grounds are professionally landscaped and include an invisible fence and irrigation system.
